verdict.rationale: Retell documents an official MCP server that lets MCP-capable clients such as Cursor, Claude Desktop and Claude Code build and manage voice agents through Retell APIs. It exposes agent tools to create, update, publish, list and fetch versions, and a probe confirms the dedicated docs page. The agent-side MCP connection docs (docs-6/23) describe client behavior and are not credited here. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, evidenced setup and auth details (transport, API-key configuration), and documented tool coverage beyond agent management.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Use Retell's MCP server to build and manage voice agents from MCP-capable clients like Cursor, Claude Desktop, and Claude Code via Retell APIs.
Retell supports the Model Context Protocol (MCP) so you can build Retell AI voice agents directly from MCP-capable clients (Cursor, Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Codex-style tools, and more).
Agents: create, update, publish, list, and fetch agent versions.
